headline: 🔥 DO: ANSWER THE FIELDSTONE BUYER'S AGENT — YOU ARE ONE DATE AWAY FROM A SIGNED CONTRACT. At 9:05 this morning he wrote back that the buyers accept every single term of your counter except one: they want to close on or before Oct 23 instead of your Oct 30, because they have four kids and will not move the week of Halloween. That reply has been sitting unanswered for roughly nine and a half hours · ⚠️ WATCH: the whole fleet went dark today — not one routine logged a run in 24 hours, so nothing was watching this deal while it moved.

notes: 🔴 THE FLEET WENT DARK FOR A FULL DAY AND NOTHING TOLD YOU. There is not a single routine run logged anywhere for Friday August 7 — the last entry of any kind is Thursday at 6:29 PM. No morning letter, no ISA sweeps, no milestone engine, no midday delta, nothing. Thursday logged 50 runs; today logged zero. ⭐ THIS IS THE EXACT FAILURE THAT WAS QUEUED AS A BUILD ON JULY 26 AND AGAIN ON AUGUST 2 AND STILL HAS NOT BEEN BUILT — catch-up-on-reopen. The fleet only runs while the desktop app is open, and when it is closed the machine does not merely pause, it goes blind: today it missed a buyer's agent accepting your counter.

🔑 TENTH CONSECUTIVE RUN BLOCKED BY ONE SIGN-IN. All three boards rebuilt and committed again tonight; none can publish. The GitHub CLI has been signed out since Monday's migration. What your phone shows is still Tuesday morning, so the board you are reading on the couch is four days stale. `gh auth login`, once, in Terminal, and everything queued ships on the next pass.

📡 THE SHOWING FEED WOKE BACK UP after 34 quiet hours — four events landed: the 355 Comanche read you were waiting on, a new Comanche booking for Monday, an Altamont showing at 6:00 tonight, and the 195 Lake View appraisal that ran this morning at 9:00. ⏸️ Agent outreach stays suspended per your own August 4 ruling, so every hit comes to you as a call, never as a machine email.

callBlock.why: 🔥 THE ONLY CALL THAT TURNS A LISTING INTO A CONTRACT TONIGHT. He wrote at 9:05 this morning: the buyers accept your price, your concession number, your co-op correction and your fridge terms — everything — and want one change, closing on or before Oct 23 instead of Oct 30. ⭐ A buyer who concedes every term but one is not negotiating anymore, he is asking permission. ⚠️ Nine and a half hours of silence on a deal that is one week of calendar apart.

🔥 THE DATE IS THEIRS TO GIVE, NOT YOURS. You asked for Oct 30 on purpose because their new build lands inside that window — so the buyers' Oct 23 request is a question only your sellers can answer. ⭐ One call settles whether seven days of calendar is worth a signed contract, and it is the same call that closes the deal.

STILL THE ONLY OTHER UNQUALIFIED YES ON YOUR BOARD, and it is now six days old. Her buyer wants to write on the Altamont unit and is short on down payment, nothing else. ⭐ THE PHONE IS THE ONLY DOOR — with agent outreach suspended by your own ruling, no machine will ever send this one for you. She also asked you a direct HVAC question on Thursday afternoon.

THE FIRST AND ONLY REPLY THE RECONNECT LANE HAS EVER PRODUCED, now going on two days old. A past client who wants something inexpensive on Lay or Logan Martin — a double-wide would do. ⭐ A live buyer who raised his own hand, and the email that earned it is getting colder as the reason to call.

🔴 STILL THE WORST NUMBER ON THIS LIST: ZERO TOUCHES, EVER, and now five days overdue. Third buyer off your 1709 Fieldstone ad, re-engaged himself on a Sunday afternoon, and nothing has ever gone out to him in any channel — on the listing that is about to go under contract.

⚠️ A PROMISE MADE IN YOUR NAME IS NOW THREE DAYS PAST DUE. Brand-new buyer off the 1709 Fieldstone ad, and the email that went out under your signature told him you would call him that day. That is the one kind of overdue that costs you the lead outright.

⭐ THE ONLY NAME HERE WITH PAPER BEHIND IT — you hold a SIGNED referral agreement on this seller, and the listing consult you booked never happened. This is not a lead to qualify; it is a commitment already made on both sides that nobody has finished.

She was back on your site 38 minutes after your pre-list email landed Thursday — that is a seller reading her own plan. ⭐ The tenant answer is now fifteen days owed and the condo scope email you promised is still out. She has stopped asking, which is worse than asking.

listings.note: 🔥 THIS IS THE WHOLE BOARD RIGHT NOW. Thursday afternoon this listing took its first offer in fourteen days. You had your recommended counter in front of the sellers inside ninety-nine minutes and out to the buyer's agent by 6:02 PM — a higher price, a corrected co-op, agreed appliances and an Oct 30 close. ⭐ AT 9:05 THIS MORNING HE ANSWERED: the buyers agree to ALL of it with exactly one exception — they want to close on or before Oct 23, not Oct 30, because they have four children and will not move the week of Halloween. ⏰ THAT IS A SEVEN-DAY GAP AND NOTHING ELSE. Price agreed. Concession agreed. Commission agreed. Appliances agreed. ⚠️ THE REPLY HAS BEEN OWED SINCE 9:05 AM — roughly nine and a half hours — and nothing in email or the text relay answers it. Stated as ABSENCE, not failure: a phone call leaves no trace in any lane this board reads. ⭐ THE DATE IS A SELLER DECISION, NOT YOURS: you asked for Oct 30 deliberately because the sellers' new build lands inside that window, so the honest sequence is seller first, then Robert. ⭐ Either date still closes inside 2026 and counts against the 45. ✅ You did text your coordinator about this file at 2:02 PM, so the deal is moving on your side even though the thread shows no answer. ⭐ Separately this listing remains your best lead source of the week — four names on tonight's call block came off this one ad, and one of them has still never been touched.

Thursday's 11:00 AM tour — the first fresh booking since three separate buyers said the number was wrong — came back: not interested, staging scored 3 of 5, and no comment written at all. ⛔ THE MOST IMPORTANT PART IS WHAT IS MISSING: the 'is it priced right' field and the 'what price' field were BOTH LEFT BLANK, exactly as they were on all three earlier reads. Four written reads on this listing and not one agent has ever named a replacement number. ⭐ THAT IS ACTUALLY THE FINDING: nobody is telling you the price is wrong anymore, they are just not writing anything — which points at the photos, the staging and the story rather than the number. ✅ AND THE TRAFFIC DID NOT STOP: a new showing is confirmed for Monday at 1:40 PM, plus a teammate's buyer asked to see it. ⛔ Quote $295,000 only — no agent has ever put a different number on paper.

It is housekeeping — which is exactly why it keeps getting skipped. ⚠️ The buyers' own home-sale contingency has still never been receipted, eight days on. ⭐ For the seller conversation: contract price is $351,000, not the $369,000 list — every repair dollar comes off a net that already carries $8,000 in closing costs and a warranty.

listings.status: 🔴 Active $450K — the counter ask is four days old and your listing agreement dies in SEVEN days
listings.note: 🔴 THE CLOCK IS NOW THE STORY. Your listing agreement on this property expires 2026-08-14 — SEVEN DAYS — while the counter under discussion proposes an Aug 31 contingency deadline, seventeen days past your authority to represent these sellers. ⏰ THAT GAP DOES NOT CLOSE BY ITSELF AND IT GETS HARDER TO RAISE THE LONGER IT WAITS. ⚠️ The buyer's agent asked for a counter number out loud, twice, and named his buyer's own ceiling while doing it — a buyer negotiating against himself, which only happens while he thinks somebody is listening. Four days of quiet is how that stops. ⚠️ Nothing outbound to either party appears in email or the text relay; stated as ABSENCE, not failure. ⚠️ THE SEQUENCE IS STILL THE PROBLEM: you cannot quote a counter your sellers have not approved, so the seller call comes first — and it is the same call that gets the agreement extended.

listings.note: 🔥 A SHOWING WENT THROUGH AT 6:00 THIS EVENING, so a second read on this unit may land tomorrow. ⚠️ MEANWHILE THE ONLY UNQUALIFIED YES ON THE BOARD IS NOW SIX DAYS OLD and its agent asked you a direct HVAC-age question Thursday afternoon. ⚠️ THE OPEN QUESTION IS A DECISION, NOT A TASK: authorize a concession and trade a later close for a signed contract, or hold at list and let her buyer wait on a bonus that may or may not arrive. ⚠️ HONEST NOTE — you still have not asked your seller for a number, which is why this is deliberately not tonight's headline decision: a decision with nothing behind it is theatre. The unblocker is one question, and you are likely to have that seller on the phone about Lake Crest anyway. ⏰ This file has also read AGREEMENT EXPIRING since 7/22 with no date ever pulled from the notice — sixteen days of an unread clock.

Fix that before anyone touches price.

money.note: ⚠️ NOTHING BOUNCED TODAY, BUT NOTHING WATCHED EITHER — AND THAT IS THE HONEST HEADLINE. The money sweep never ran: the fleet was dark all day, so no routine checked the balance, the bill calendar or the runway. What CAN be said from the bank's own mail is genuinely good news: several ordinary withdrawals and one deposit posted, and there was NO returned item, NO insufficient-funds notice and NO low-balance warning in the last 24 hours. That is a second clean day in a row on the only signal that was actually observable. ⚠️ TWO THINGS FROM THURSDAY ARE UNCHANGED AND UNRESOLVED. First, the accounting system's connection to the bank EXPIRED and has not been re-linked, so every cash figure the books report remains unusable and materially overstated — the only trustworthy number is the one stamped by the bank itself. Second, two large recurring bills the calendar said would draft did NOT draft, which sounds like relief and is not: the calendar was wrong, the money is still owed, and nobody currently knows the real dates. ⭐ THE MONTH ITSELF IS STILL NOT THE PROBLEM: August models above the survive line. September is the hole and it is still at zero — which is exactly why the Fieldstone date question matters tonight.

The design is every ~30 minutes through the send window plus an instant responder on inbound; Thursday delivered on that with roughly twenty passes. Today delivered none, because the fleet only runs while the desktop app is open. ⭐ THAT IS THE COST OF THE MISSING CATCH-UP BUILD, AND TODAY IT WAS MEASURABLE: a buyer's agent accepted your counter at 9:05 AM and no routine saw it for nine hours. 🛑 THE RECONNECT LANE REMAINS HELD AT THE EXECUTOR AND WILL NOT SEND UNTIL YOU RULE.
